cases.question: What data do we have available to query in Omni? Give me an overview of our topics and what they cover.
cases.ground_truth: Models listed, SHARED model identified, topics listed with descriptions. Each topic's base view and purpose summarized.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni models list and identifies the SHARED model (not the SCHEMA model) as the one to explore
The agent calls omni models list-topics with the SHARED model ID to get the topic list
The agent summarizes each topic by name and purpose — not just by listing raw API response fields

cases.question: I want to query revenue data. What fields and measures are available, and how do the relevant tables join together?
cases.ground_truth: Most relevant topic inspected. Available revenue measures identified by name and aggregate type. Join relationships between views explained.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni models get-topic to inspect the relevant topic in detail — not just list topics
The agent identifies specific measure names (e.g., total_revenue) and their aggregate types from the topic response
The agent describes the join relationships from the topic's relationships[] — which views join to which, and on what condition

cases.question: I'm about to remove the 'sale_price' field from the model. What will break?
cases.ground_truth: Field impact analysis run: branch created with field removed, content validator run against the branch, YAML searched for references. Full blast radius reported.
expected_behavior: The agent creates a model branch and removes the field there, or verifies that an existing branch actually has the field removed — it does not touch the production model to assess impact
The agent reads branch YAML or validates the branch setup before treating content-validator output as deletion impact
The agent runs omni models content-validator-get --branch-id to find broken dashboards and tiles
The agent also searches the model YAML for references to sale_price in other views, topics, or calculated fields
The agent reports both broken content (from the validator) and model references (from YAML search) before recommending any action

cases.question: Show me the AI context configured on the order_items topic — I want to understand what Blobby knows about this data.
cases.ground_truth: Topic inspected with get-topic. ai_context, sample_queries, and ai_fields values returned and summarized clearly.
expected_behavior: The agent calls omni models get-topic to retrieve the topic detail — it does not guess or hallucinate the ai_context content
The agent reports the actual ai_context text from the API response
The agent reports configured ai_fields or AI field-selection values from the topic response or topic YAML
If sample_queries are present in the topic, the agent includes their names, prompts, and relevant query fields in the summary
